IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_fr: A fancy rat will be your new scouting buddy. It will not fight or help with livestock, but it notices trouble further out than almost anything else in the mod and is the quietest about it. Strays turn up in houses, farm buildings, and anywhere cluttered or grubby. Warehouses, kitchens, storage rooms, basements.
IGUI_PD_BadFood_fr: Bad for rats. Eating this makes it sick and breaks its trust.
IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc_fr: Full sentinel watch. Quietly squeaks at distant zombies, or will let out a sharp, urgent squeak for close zombies or large groups. May alert zombies. The default.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc_fr: Stealth watch. Keeps quiet and careful, will let out a discreet heads-up that won't give away your position.
IGUI_PD_AlertGroup_fr: Your %1 squeaks urgently! A group of zombies!
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData_fr: No record yet, visit this rat once
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc_fr: Your rat is hungry. Feed it before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc_fr: Your rat is thirsty. Give it water before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc_fr: You slept soundly with your rat curled up beside you. For a while you feel calm and rested: panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc_fr: Your rat is weak: it has gone a long time without protein. It obeys less.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc_fr: You fed it something rats shouldn't eat. Your rat is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_fr: Your rat is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip_fr: Pups that never grow up? Wish real life had that toggle :D
IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata_fr: There is no record of that rat to call it back.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Scurry_desc: Seen only by the darkness. While your rat is fed, watered and bonded to you, your Nimble, Lightfooted and Sneak experiences are increased.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc_fr: Send the rat to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick_fr: Click where to send the rat. Right click cancels.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc_fr: Hold an item and the rat memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem_fr: Hold the item you want the rat to smell.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc_fr: The rat forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc_fr: Hold an item and the rat memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem_fr: Hold the item you want the rat to look for.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc_fr: The rat forgets what it was looking for and stops going out while you sleep.
